subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

Many orthodox people have a ____ (hostile) attitude towards the idea of women getting educated and employed.
solution:
The correct answer is '**belligerent**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**belligerent**" means hostile and aggressive. (आक्रामक)
 
• The sentence highlights an orthodox view where people are resistant to the idea of women getting educated and employed, reflecting hostility.
 
• The other options: "**friendly**," "**meticulous**," and "**elaborate**" do not convey the required meaning of hostility.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Many orthodox people have a belligerent__ attitude towards the idea of women getting educated and employed.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Friendly (मैत्रीपूर्ण)**: means kind and pleasant, which does not fit the context.
 
• **Meticulous (सूक्ष्म)**: means very careful and precise, irrelevant to the sentence's context.
 
• **Elaborate (विस्तृत)**: means involving many details, unrelated to hostility.
